violation_type.title: Furnishings and Equipment for Toddlers - Items Accessible to Children (26 TAC §746.2505(3))
violation_type.short_title: Furnishings and Equipment for Toddlers - Items Accessible to Children
violation_type.typical_finding: During the investigation there was enough evidence to support that the operation was not providing enough accessible toys and equipment to the children in their care for daily use.

finding_variants.text: During the investigation there was enough evidence to support that the operation was not providing enough accessible toys and equipment to the children in their care for daily use.
Toys and supplies were not accesible to the children.
During the course of the investigation, it was determined that caregivers turn shelves around where children do not have access to toys.

Observed two toddler classrooms who did not have toys in the reach of children. One classroom had the shelf blocking the other shelf which had the toys on them. The other classroom had the shelf turned around and toys on top of the shelf.     This was corrected when the toys were put in the reach of the children and Shelves were moved.

During the inspection it was observed that the toddler classroom only had a couple toys available and did not have low shelving for storage of the toys so that the children could play and access the toys without adult supervision.
Follow up: 5/12/26: The toddler room does not have accessible toys for children to access independently.

occurrences.finding: Furnishings and Equipment for Toddlers - Items Accessible to Children: Follow up: 5/12/26: The toddler room does not have accessible toys for children to access independently.

Furnishings and Equipment for Toddlers - Items Accessible to Children: Based on a review of the video of the incident and my observation during the investigation inspection the operation does not have easily accessible toys for the children without adult intervention.

Furnishings and Equipment for Toddlers - Items Accessible to Children: During the course of the investigation, it was determined that caregivers turn shelves around where children do not have access to toys.
Furnishings and Equipment for Toddlers - Items Accessible to Children: The toddler room was seen with toys out of reach of the children.
Furnishings and Equipment for Toddlers - Items Accessible to Children: Caregiver did not sanitize the diaper changing mat after each use.

Furnishings and Equipment for Toddlers - Items Accessible to Children: During the follow-up it was observed that in one of the toddler classrooms there were no toys on low shelving to allow the children access without adult supervision and in the other toddler classroom there were some toys on low shelves, however the caregiver was deciding what toys they would be playing with as a group rather than allowing the children a choice.

occurrences.finding: Furnishings and Equipment for Toddlers - Items Accessible to Children: The toddler room does not have shelves in the room for the children to access independently.

Furnishings and Equipment for Toddlers - Items Accessible to Children: The toddler classroom had majority of the shelves turned towards the wall and the toys were inaccessible to children in care. This was observed during morning activities with 1.5 hour of time prior to nap time. Two music based toys were made accessible after the initial observations but the shelves that were faced away were not turned with available toys during the duration of the inspection.
